It would also make it easier for fossil fuel companies to drill for oil or lay new gas pipelines. Vox’s Sara Herschander breaks down the bipartisan bill.

The Gray Area is taking a break today — but we’ve got something special for you.

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

We’re dropping an episode from one of our favorite podcasts, Unexplainable from Vox. In it, host Sally Helm considers whether or not it’s ethical to kill lantern flies, an invasive species that has gained a foothold on the East Coast of the US.

In the episode Sally explores what we owe other living creatures, how squishing bugs changes us, and what we should do when there is not a single clear moral path.

​మీ కిచెన్‌లో బాగా ఉపయోగపడే ఈ సింపుల్ టిప్ తప్పకుండా ట్రై చేసి చూడండి.
